title: COSUIZA — Corpus de documentos hispánicos de Suiza
institution: GRAFILA (Grupo de Análisis Filológico de Lausana), Section d'espagnol, Université de Lausanne; CHARTA network member
region: Documents kept in Swiss archives (Basel, Fribourg, Bern, Geneva, Valais, Vaud, Lausanne), written mostly in Spain and Spanish America
notes: 123 TEITOK documents (stats page 'action=stats', checked 2026-10-12): non-literary manuscripts edited following the CHARTA criteria (palaeographic and critical presentation, TEI XML with lemma/POS). Raw TEI XML is served per document. Part of the CHARTA network. The counts cover the 27 documents dated within 1450-1700, but 70 of the 123 documents have no date in their TEI header, so the period share is understated, and the corpus is under construction. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
